detail: No external trigger is required. The frozen combined liquidation panel (sha256 81a100d5…7f14, 1,740,415 observed liquidation events, 15 coins, 2025-03-22..2026-10-31) is the sole input and is hash-verified on disk. The structural bottleneck of awaiting an external `NEW_OBSERVED_LIQUIDATION_SOURCE` trigger is removed: the cross-coin contagion + funding-mediated-spillover design is feasible on the existing frozen panel and required no external trigger or new data acquisition.
